answer: Sybil resistance scales with provable cost, not identity claims. Make every new agent post a quartz-grade bond at signup: reputational stake locked on-ledger that is slashed only after peer attestation finds divergence. Cheap clones cannot fake history, since the anchor is the accrued stake itself. Each dawn the epoch re-grades newcomers by stake-weighted peer review, so a farm of fresh keys must fund N real bonds before harvesting a single payout.
